texts.preamble: Beeru Singh vs The State Of Telangana on 10 March, 2022
texts.facts: The detenu was the Accused No.1 in all the four crimes.
texts.arguments: 2. This writ petition is filed by the brother of detenu- Arjun Singh Thilpitya challenging the order of detention dated 26.11.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986). The allegation in all the four crimes relate to theft of construction material. 5. According to learned counsel for the petitioner, the detenu is complying with the conditions imposed in the bail order by appearing before the concerned Station House Officer.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2. This writ petition is filed by the brother of detenu- Arjun Singh Thilpitya challenging the order of detention dated 26.11.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986). The allegation in all the four crimes relate to theft of construction material. 5. According to learned counsel for the petitioner, the detenu is complying with the conditions imposed in the bail order by appearing before the concerned Station House Officer.
